## Type of Change

<!-- #

- [ ] `feat` - New feature or functionality.
- [ ] `fix` — Bug fix.
- [ ] `docs` — Documentation changes.
- [ ] `style` — Formatting or style changes without behavior changes.
- [ ] `refactor` — Code restructuring without behavior changes.
- [ ] `perf` — Performance improvement.
- [ ] `test` — Tests or test coverage.
- [ ] `build` — Build system or dependency changes.
- [ ] `ci` — Continuous Integration changes.
- [ ] `chore` — Maintenance changes.
- [ ] `revert` — Reverts a previous change.

## Contribution Checklist

Before requesting a review, please make sure that:

- [ ] My changes follow the project's existing conventions.
- [ ] My commits follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] My Pull Request addresses one focused change or a clearly related set of changes.
- [ ] I have reviewed my own changes.
- [ ] I have removed unnecessary files, debug code, and unrelated changes.
- [ ] Tests pass locally.
- [ ] Documentation has been updated when necessary.
- [ ] I have not included credentials, secrets, or private information.
- [ ] This Pull Request is ready for review.
